verifications.claim: An EGOT is the accomplishment of winning an Emmy, Grammy, Oscar, and Tony.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Achieving an Emmy, a Grammy, an Oscar, and a Tony (EGOT)" (R1); "To be an EGOT winner means winning at least one Emmy, Grammy, Oscar and Tony" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: All references consistently define EGOT as winning all four awards.

verifications.claim: As of early 2026, only 22 people have achieved EGOT.

verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly state 22 as of early 2026, post-Spielberg.
